description: This file defines a mixin class for lazy initialization of neural network modules in PyTorch, including protocols for attribute checks, hooks, and methods for handling uninitialized parameters.

classes.name: _LazyProtocol
classes.description: A protocol class used for type checking and attribute validation in lazy modules.

classes.name: LazyModuleMixin
classes.description: A mixin class providing lazy parameter initialization, hooks, and related methods for PyTorch modules.

methods.name: _save_to_state_dict
methods.description: Saves parameters and buffers to a state dictionary, handling uninitialized parameters.

methods.name: _lazy_load_hook
methods.description: Hook for loading state dicts into lazy modules, materializing uninitialized parameters if needed.

methods.name: initialize_parameters
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize parameters based on input, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: has_uninitialized_params
methods.description: Checks if the module has any uninitialized (lazy) parameters.

methods.name: _infer_parameters
methods.description: Infers parameter sizes from input data by running a forward pass.

methods.name: _replicate_for_data_parallel
methods.description: Raises an error if used with DataParallel when parameters are uninitialized.
